pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of pyramiding into positions when current floating PnL is negative; maximum of 1 active position per directional impulse until break-even stop is locked.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a 15-minute ATR breakout confirmation paired with zero high-impact news scheduled within the next 30 minutes before any market order is authorized.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing harvest when floating profit reaches $10.00 to guarantee minimum asymmetric returns of $15-$30+.
